Information.Subtext: How to use the protocol

Interprete.DefaultValue:
To start tracking repositories, add one to the repositories table. This can be done via the context menu or via the add repository page. Both will ask for the repository owner and name, both can be found in the url of the github repository.
By default this element runs without an api key. This means that the element can only sent 60 request per hour before being blocked out by Github. To get more request you can add an api key under General/Configuration page. To generate such a token you can go to Github.com -> Settings -> Developer settings -> Personal access tokens -> tokens (classic), to generate one.

Changes.Change: Changed the way the context menu works. Now you can more easily add/remove repos from automation scripts

Changes.NewFeature: Added workflows table to the connector.
Added option to track all the repositories under an organization
Added a way to create automation scripts workflows
Added the Nuget Solution CICD Workflow
Added the Internal Nuget Solution CICD Workflow
Added InterApp Functionality for adding/removing repositories, creating workflows

Changes.Fix: Made id's type long because it was causing int overflows
Changed the workflow tag versioning regex, to be more consistent.
Changes.Change: Clear tables that are no longer polled, to not have out dated information
Added a decent error message when trying to add a workflow to a repository that the public keys are not yet available

Changes.Fix: Fixed bug where some lingering rows would come back.
Fixed IndexOutOfRange exception when no repositories are present

Changes.Change: Add the ability to execute workflows via InterApp
Changed the inputs dictionary for the execute workflow request to a Dictionary<string, string> to prevent serialization issues when using InterApp

Changes.NewFeature: Handle the adding of custom workflows
Can now also add variables to repositories
Added Table Cleanup to IAC Messages Table

Change.Impact: All tables are now partials 'GetTable' via automation scripts will only be able to retrieve the displayed content.

ActionsToTake.ActionToTake: Make sure the automation scripts that rely on the connector page through the table correctly.

Changes.Fix: Table cleanups happens more frequently and you should have less stale data.
Changes.Change: The Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) is now available in a seperate page per repository.
All tables are now partial, because polling on organization in it's entirety is too much data.
